raw.details:
Tata Elxsi TELIPORT Season 4

Theme: "Script your future!" with an AI-first approach to Design and Product Engineering
Host: Tata Elxsi | Platform: Grad Partners

Key Dates

Item Date
Competition runs 23 Sep 2026 to 30 Mar 2027
Registration deadline 23 Oct 2026, 23:59 IST
Round 1 submission window 23 Sep, 11:00 to 24 Oct 2026, 23:59 IST
Round 2 submission window 14 Nov, 10:00 to 13 Dec 2026, 23:59 IST
Round 3 (Grand Finale) To be announced

The page shows about 15 days left. The "Registration Deadline: 23rd Oct'27" under Important Dates appears to be a typo for 2026, since the top banner says Oct '26.

Eligibility:

  • Pre-final and final year Engineering students (B.Tech, M.Tech, Integrated Dual Degree), graduating in 2027 or 2028
  • Open to all engineering colleges in India
  • Teams of 2 to 3 members
  • All members must be from the same college. Cross-college teams are not allowed.
  • Cross-year, cross-specialization and cross-course teams are allowed

Enrollment: CLICK HERE

Rounds:

Round 1: Idea Submission

  • Registered teams get access to the case studies and choose one problem statement.
  • Submit a single slide (PDF format) on that problem statement only.
  • Assessors and a jury shortlist the top entries.
  • Once submitted, your idea becomes the exclusive property of Tata Elxsi.

Round 2: Detailed Submission

  • Shortlisted teams build a full solution with an implementation roadmap.
  • Submit a 10-slide PPT, plus any multimedia or prototype.
  • Teams that make Round 2 submissions get PPI opportunities.
  • The best teams are selected as National Finalists.

Round 3: Grand Finale

  • Finalists present to a panel of senior Tata Elxsi leaders.
  • Teams compete for the title of National Winner.
